按照那个想法，那些属于较小行政区的居民，就只因为属于一个地理上较小的区，便成了「那些卑微的灵魂」（animae viles），任凭那个毫无经验的办事员在自己身上把自己磨练成一名官员。——既然在别处供受过大学教育的法学家在真正的官员监督与指导下、为取得一个官职而作的准备的那种法律实务，在这里完全落到了文书吏身上，那么这些文书吏的重要性，无论相对于一位毫无经验的上司，还是就其自身而言，都显而易见了：一个统辖两万乃至更多人口、并且把警察权与行政权的各分支连同司法权一并集于一身的上级官员，其助手却只有文书吏。

en: The main part in the picture of the institution or absurdity (for the absurdity of the scribal business appears in the speeches and petitions almost as a technical and recognized expression for the scribal institution) is however that monopoly which is allotted to the town and office clerks.

Further, in order to exercise it, they keep, as needed, 10 or 20 writing subjects, whom they keep partly with them at the centre and partly send out into the small towns and villages in order to write.
A detail of the business which they have to write must be read in the opinion itself.

Apart from the business of the tax repartition, of writing tax notes and tax receipt books, of determining the taxable property of each individual citizen, of noting the changes brought about by the sale of houses, estates, marriages, etc., and likewise the repartition of the communal expenses of the so-called city and office burden133), two subjects above all are to be distinguished in which the pressure and absurdity of the scribal business seems to have its most aristocratic seat.

Firstly, they have to prepare the records of non-contentious jurisdiction, contracts, marriage contracts, in particular the wills, the inventories of the property brought in, i.e. of the property of a new married couple, the estate inventories at auctions, the partitions of inheritances, and the like.

About the latter objects it says, for example (z. B.), at the place cited at S. 65: 'In almost all partitions of inheritance there is not as much money as the writing fees amount to; the best piece of property is therefore publicly sold in order to get cash; with newlyweds it goes no better: either the costs of the inventory consume the little money they have scraped together sourly in their unmarried state, or they must already at the start get into debt or sell a piece of property' etc., and as the consequence of such procedures the general impoverishment of the lower class of the people is stated.

An unmarried couple, for example, therefore cannot themselves draw up the inventory which according to the local laws is to be taken, or have it written by anyone whoever and then have it confirmed by the court; only the monopoly holder of writing can do this; and with what prolixity and at what cost he carries out his work in general will be spoken of immediately. - In the petitions and other statements the complaints are unanimous, both about the nature of the legal arrangements themselves, which entail an endless scribal business and unimaginable costs, and about the extortions and the absurdity which double and tenfold the legally permitted. - The other further noteworthy occupation of the scribal men is the preparation of the mayoral, i.e. the communal, and other relevant accounts, then of the poor-fund, church, alms, hospital and nursing accounts, in short the accounts of the poor and church funds, - furthermore that they also have the probation and revision of the communal and guardianship accounts. - Here now a quite peculiar circumstance comes to light: that those mayors and administrators of other communal property, poor funds, etc. do not themselves draw up the accounts of the administration of their treasuries, or privately take care of this business, but must have it prepared from the writing factory of the office clerk.
The costs are charged to the municipality, and here the name 'office burden', under which they are entered, is quite appropriate.
zh: 不过，这幅关于这个机构、或者关于这场弊害的图画（因为「文书吏之弊」在演说与请愿书中几乎成了一项技术性的、被公认的对「文书吏衙门」的称呼）中的主要部分，却是那项授予城市与事务文书官的垄断权。
为了行使这项垄断，他们按需要随时备着十名、二十名可供驱使的文书人手：一部分留在自己身边、就在中心，一部分则派到各小镇与村庄去写东西。
至于他们须要书写的事务的细节，则须自行阅读那份意见书。
除了税赋分摊的事务、开具税收凭单与税收收入账簿、核定每一个公民的应税财产、记录房屋、田产与婚姻买卖所造成的变动等等，以及同样地对所谓「城市与事务费用」的自治支出所作的分摊133)之外，尤其应当标出两类事项；文书吏衙门那种压迫与弊害，似乎在其中安坐在最显赫的位置上。
第一，他们须要制作非诉讼案件的卷宗、契约、婚书，尤其是遗嘱、嫁妆清册（即一对新婚夫妇财产的清册）、遗产拍卖清册、遗产分割文书等等。
关于后几类事项，所引之处 S. 65 上说（例如，z. B.）：「在几乎所有的遗产分割中，可供分配的现钱都还没有文书费那么多；因此，为了拿到现钱，最上等的一块地产便被公开拍卖；在新婚者那里情况也好不到哪里去：要么是清册费用把他们在未婚时辛辛苦苦攒下的那一点钱消耗殆尽，要么他们一开始就不得不举债或卖掉一块地产」等等；而作为这类程序的后果，人们指出了下层人民阶级的普遍贫困化。

因此，一对未婚夫妇例如就不能自己去开列那份按当地法律应当开列的清册，也不能随便交给谁去写，然后再让法院加以确认；只有那位书写垄断者才能办这件事；至于他办理这些工作究竟是如何的冗繁、又是如何的昂贵，下面马上就会说到。——在请愿书与其他陈述中，控诉是一致的：一方面控诉这些法定安排本身的性质——它们招致的是无穷无尽的抄写与难以言说的费用；另一方面控诉那些勒索与弊害，它们把法律所许可的东西翻上一倍、翻上十倍。——文书吏的另一项颇值得注意的差事，是制作市长的、也就是自治市的以及其他同类账目，其次是济贫基金、教会、施舍、医院与救济的账目，总之是关于济贫基金与教会基金的账目；此外他们还负责对自治市账目与监护账目的审核与复核。——这时便显出一个十分特殊的实情：那些市长，以及其他公共财产、济贫基金等等的管理者，并不自行编制其库房管理的账目，也不私下操办这项事务，而必须让人从事务文书官的「文书工厂」里把它们做出来。
这些费用被记在自治市的账上；在这里，「事务费用」这个名目——它们正是被归在这个名目之下——大概十分贴切。

en: As regards first the aspect of these costs which arise for the municipalities in this way, glaring examples of them are cited, for example that the drawing up of the account of a newly Württemberg municipality, for which the costs formerly amounted to 1 fl.

30 kr., has now through the newly introduced old Württemberg scribal method risen to 50 fl.; for a hamlet which for want of revenues formerly needed no account at all, the art knew how to produce one now which came to 56 fl.
20 kr. amounted to (Abt. XVIII, S. 99 f.).

These and a great many other examples would be amusing to read if they were not at the same time unheard-of and infamous extortions; just one more case: the communal account files of a place called Mögglingen were given one after another to a series of scribal men by the town clerk for preparation; for these together, none of whom had written a single word of the account, the municipality had to pay the sum of 900 fl., say nine hundred gulden, for reading through and memorizing the files; one carried it this way, another that; that much the account cost before a single line had been written on it, and he who finally really made it must of course rightly have his trouble paid for once more for the whole.
zh: 至于这些费用使自治市背负的这一面，首先须要说明的方面是人们从中援引了刺眼的实例：例如，一个新符腾堡自治市的账目编制费用原先只要 1 古尔登，
30 十字币，如今由于新引入的老符腾堡文书吏方法而涨到了 50 古尔登；至于一个从前因为没有收入而不需要任何账目的小村落，这门本事如今也晓得要给它做一份，而这份账目竟达到 56 古尔登，
20 十字币（《文件补编》 XVIII, S. 99 f.）。

这些以及大量别的例子，若不是同时也是前所未闻的、可耻的勒索，读来倒也有趣；这里再举一例：默格林根这个地方的自治市账册卷宗，被城市文书官先后交给一批文书吏去制作；自治市却不得不为阅卷与背记卷宗而付给这批人一共 900 古尔登，也就是九百古尔登；一个人把它往这边送，另一个人又往那边送；在账上一个字都还没写之前，这本账就已经花掉了这么多；而最终真正把它做出来的那个人，他的辛劳当然也理所当然地又要由大家公摊付酬。

en: One of the most striking complaints among the land's grievances compiled by the assembly of the estates is the in part so considerable increase of the administrative costs of the property of the municipalities, of the poor funds, etc.; it attributes all the evil to the abolition of the old constitution.

From the statements which are available about the scribal institution it is evident that these complaints were raised especially in the newly added parts of the land, and the printed detailed municipal accounts also show that it is precisely the introduction of this old Württemberg absurdity which brought about an enormous increase of the administrative costs.

Much more could be cited, from the unauthorised additions to the accounts, the prolixity of the accounts (among other things, in the municipal poor-fund and similar accounts which have to be prepared in duplo or triplo, even the slips of the artisans are inserted again in extenso, and indeed also in duplo and triplo) and so on. - With this practice of sucking the citizens dry, both in a lawful and in an unlawful manner, is connected the glaring picture which is made of the morals of this estate, of its ignorance, roughness, clumsiness, arrogance, etc.; Abt. XVIII, S. 9 ff.

It says at S. 40 in the same place, 'that this estate was held in no esteem in Württemberg at any time; in the respect which from time to time was shown with so much justice to individual individuals of it, there lay silently the contempt for the estate as a whole, because excellent scribal men were always a great rarity'.

The glaring colours which one indeed reads already in the first chapter of this opinion are not so much rubbed in by the author as merely a compilation from the writings which have appeared about that estate by other, older and newer writers, and which give a unanimous testimony; - among them there are even some authors who belonged to this estate themselves and must have known it best.
One can hardly say anything harder of a class of men than these descriptions contain.
zh: 在等级会议所汇编的土地陈情中，最引人注目的控诉之一，是自治市财产、济贫基金等等的管理费用在某些方面大幅增加；它把一切弊害都归咎于旧宪法的扬弃。
从关于文书吏衙门所得的各项陈述可以看出，这些控诉特别是在新归并的各地区提出的；而那些付印的详细自治市账目同样显示：正是这项老符腾堡弊害的引入，造成了管理费用的巨大增长。
还可以举出许多别的例子：擅自加账、账目的冗长（在须作两份或三份制作的自治市济贫基金及其他类似账目中，连手工业者的凭条也照原文整份抄录，而且还要抄成两份或三份），等等。——这种无论在合法还是不合法的情况下都要榨取公民的做法，与人们对这一阶层的品行——它的无知、粗野、笨拙、傲慢等等——所作的那幅刺眼的描绘是连在一起的；《文件补编》 XVIII, S. 9 ff.
同一处 S. 40 说：「这一阶层在符腾堡从来不受尊敬；人们时不时地对其中个别人士所表示的那种完全正当的敬重，暗中包含着对整个阶层的轻蔑，因为出色的文书吏一向是极为罕见的。」
而且人们在这份意见的第一章里就读到了那些刺眼的色彩；它们与其说是出自作者之手，不如说只是从其他那些年长与年近的著述家就这一阶层所写的文字中汇辑而来的，而这些文字给出的是一份众口一词的证词；——甚至其中还有几位作者，本身就属于这一阶层，因而必定最了解它。
对一整个人的阶层，人们很难说出比这些描绘所包含的更严厉的话了。

en: Still more far-reaching than all the rest is the circumstance that the very sum which his dispatched scribal men earn or extort for their work according to their bills of account must be paid to the principal, the town and office clerk.
Thus a peculiar kind of relationship now enters in.

The principal not only has the monopoly of writing in his district, but the very same thing which his scribal men earn for themselves, and over whose exaggeration such loud complaint has already been made, must be paid over to him - not for a work performed on his own part, but, so to speak, as to the dynast.
This payment to the town or office clerk is independent of the seigneurial taxes which are still laid on such writings, and falls into his private purse.

It says rightly about this at S. 137 at the place cited: 'That the scribal men are always the money-makers of the town and office clerks, that these always only profit by every illegal and exaggerated addition to the accounts and every prolixity of their subordinates, - nothing can be devised worse than this arrangement.' - The idea of a dynastic or feudal relationship, according to which the town and office clerk levies dues on the citizens, as it were on subjects or writing-serfs, as one might call them, appears fully developed in the case cited at Abt. XVIII, S. 57.

An office clerk in the past year charged a tenant, who had inherited a deceased brother, a Catholic priest, and had obtained dispensation from the inventory and the partition, the sum of 200 fl., because through the dispensation he could not come by his partition fees.

It is further stated there that the heir really did pay the sum and that the office clerk pocketed it without having put pen to paper, and it is furthermore not noted that this extortion had any reimbursement, penal servitude or other punishment as a consequence.
Obligations which arise from the feudal relation do indeed contain in part a right of the lord of the manor in land and soil, in part the duty of protecting his vassals.

But those fees which the town and office clerk draws are also free of such conditions. - If the Württemberg citizens really are burdened with this scribal serfdom or writing bondage - as it seems to be the case in fact and as the estates cannot well deny -, then it would at least be more expedient and also more just to turn the advantage of this subjection over to the state and to farm out this monopoly in its name134), instead of those dues, which are not the payment for any work, falling only into the pockets of private persons, some of whom thereby, as it says at Abt. XVIII S. 111, stand on a level with an Austrian and French bishop.
zh: 比这一切都更为要害的是这样一件事：他派出去的文书吏按他们的账单为工作而挣得或勒索来的那笔款项，同样必须付给他们的头目——那位城市与事务文书官。
于是，一种奇特的关系就此形成了。
头目不仅在他自己的区内握有书写的垄断权；而且那些文书吏为自己挣得的东西——人们早已对他们的浮夸提出过如此强烈的抱怨——必须原封不动地缴付给他：这不是为他自己所做的某项工作而付的报酬，而简直是向一位世家老爷缴纳的租子。
缴给城市或事务文书官的这一笔钱，与仍加在这些文书上的领主税费无关，而是落进了他个人的钱袋。
关于这一点，所引之处 S. 137 说得十分中肯：「文书吏始终是城市与事务文书官的造钱机器；这些头目在下属每一次非法而夸大的加账与铺张中，永远只有收益；——再没有比这更坏的制度可以想出来了。」——那种世家关系或封地关系的想法——城市与事务文书官仿佛向臣民、向人们不妨称之为「抄写农奴」的居民征收贡赋——在《文件补编》 XVIII, S. 57 所举的那个例子里表现得淋漓尽致。
去年有一位事务文书官向一位承租人开列了 200 古尔登的账目；这位承租人继承了一位已故的兄弟——一位天主教神父——并从财产清册与遗产分割中获得了豁免，理由是他因这一豁免而免去了自己的分割费用。
同一处还进一步指出：那位继承人确实把这笔钱付了，而事务文书官连笔都没动就把它收进了腰包；而文中也没有提到，这一勒索带来了退赔、苦役或其他什么处罚。
源自封地关系的义务，到底总还包含着：一方面是封主对土地与地基的权利，另一方面是他对其封臣的保护义务。

不过，城市与事务文书官所收取的那些费用，倒是免于这类条件的。——如果符腾堡的公民真的背负着这种「文书吏的奴役」或「书写的农奴制」（事实看来正是如此，而等级议会大概也无法否认），那么至少把这种臣属身份的好处转归国家、由国家之名把这项垄断权租出去134)，总归要更为得体、也更为公道；否则这些既不是任何劳动报酬的贡赋，就只会落进私人者的钱袋，而其中一些人不正如《文件补编》 XVIII S. 111 所说，地位堪比奥地利与法国的一位主教吗。

en: It has been mentioned that the mayors as well as other community heads, administrators of poor funds and the like do not themselves draw up the accounts of their administration, but that this business belongs to the privileged scribal man.
It is already important that those municipal officials and administrators of foundations are kept in a legitimate incapacity by such an arrangement.

But of greater weight than this circumstance and even than the cost burden considered above, which arises for the municipalities and the other funds from this, is the dependence into which thereby all the community heads of a district are placed with regard to the town and office clerk.
About this side which reaches further into the state organism there is found XVIII.

Abt., S. 97 a description in a petition from Gmünd, which presents the monster of the scribal business in its various branches with official documentary evidence135); about the [branch] of which there is talk here it says: 'In communal accounts the scribal man sports himself with all the papers of the journal, of the annexes and of the receipts of the so-called accountant, without giving any special certificate for it.

From that moment the mayor is his slave; he has slept his last quiet sleep, for the thought that his credit, his honour and his good name are in the hands of a strange unknown man torments him unceasingly.
Many a scribal man now immediately has interim payments made to him and travels off with them into another region of the empire.

When at last the business is begun by one of the successors, the period of suffering of the accountant begins; he has made impossible expenditures, receipts are missing, a considerable deficit shows itself; the prospect that lies before the accountant is the fortress or the penal servitude.

If the one who knows himself to be innocent has now reached this point of desperation, then, after the appropriate measures have been taken, the matter is started afresh, the receipts are found again or made, and so on.

The accountant, together with the figures or documentary witnesses appearing in the process, signs his account, which is unintelligible to him everywhere, and understands just as little as in the case of the deficit formerly charged to him, that in the end a credit balance is coming to him.
zh: 前面已经提到，市长以及其他社区首长、济贫基金的管理者等等，并不自行编制其管理的账目，这项差事归那位享有特权的文书吏所有。
光是这一安排使那些自治市官员与基金会管理者处于一种正当的无能状态，这件事本身就已经重要了。
然而，比这一情形、乃至比刚才所考察的、由此而由自治市与其他基金承担的费用开销更有分量的，是：这样一个区里所有的社区首长，就此都处在了城市与事务文书官的支配之下。
关于这一进一步伸入国家机体的方面，《文件补编》 XVIII.
《文件补编》 S. 97 有一篇格明德的请愿书中的记述，它用官方文件为证据，按各个分支展示了文书吏事务这件怪物的真相135)；关于这里所谈的那个[分支]，它说：「在自治市账目上，文书吏把那位所谓会计的账簿、附件与收据一股脑儿地玩弄于股掌之间，却不为它出具任何专门的凭证。
从这一刻起，市长就成了他的奴隶；他已睡完了最后一个安稳觉，因为想到自己的信誉、荣誉与名声交托在一个自己根本不认识的外人手里，这个念头就不断地折磨着他。
许多文书吏立刻就让人给自己预付一笔款，带着这笔钱迁往帝国的另一个地方去。
等到这摊差事终于由他的某个继任者接手时，会计的受难期便开始了：他支出了无法报销的款项，收据不翼而飞，出现了一笔可观的亏空；摆在这位会计面前的，不是城堡就是苦役。
如果这个明知自己无辜的人已到了这样绝望的地步，那么，在采取了合适的手段之后，事情又被拉回正轨，收据被重新找到，或者补办，等等。
这位会计连同在此过程中出现的那些人物与文书见证人，在一份他处处都看不懂的账目上签了字；而他同先前被归咎于他的那笔亏空一样，始终弄不明白：到头来等待着他的原来是一笔结余。

en: The community heads are thus in such hands, and the people are in such hands!
'My people, your leaders deceive you!' - when they speak of the good old law, one would like to call out with the prophet.

But in so far as one is unlikely to take that description, as regards the personal, as generally valid, just as certainly the necessary dependence of the community heads, of the municipalities and - taken together with the further business department of the scribal business mentioned above - also of the individual citizens upon the town and office clerks does not proceed from the personalities, but from such institutions.
Those community heads formerly elected the deputies to the diet alone, and of the members of the committees the greater part was from the class of the scribal men.

In the Griesinger opinion at S. 72 it says: 'The improvement or even the recasting of the scribal institution had to find its greatest opponents in the representatives of the estates, who were for the most part themselves scribal men or at least had an influence on scribal men, because every main improvement stood in the most obvious contradiction to their interest.' - With this everything is said.

But what appeared as something one had, as a past of the earlier diets and estates' committees, was it not also a condition, as also the history of this assembly of the estates itself? Has it done anything effective to sweep away such an Augean stable? Has it not raged in its own entrails?

Have the endlessly repeated efforts of Mr von Forstner, who did not tire of their delays, succeeded in bringing about even after a year and a day a single report of the committee, much less that a deliberation or even a resolution had been entered into the matter?136)
zh: 于是，社区首长们就在这样的手里，而人民也在这样的手里！
「我的人民，你们的领袖在欺骗你们！」——当他们谈论那部良好的旧法时，人们不禁想随先知一同呼出这句话。
不过，就个人而言，人们大概不会把上述那番描绘当作普遍适用；同样确定无疑的是：社区首长、自治市、乃至（连同上面提到的文书吏衙门那另一项业务范围一起算入的）个别市民对城市与事务文书官的那种必然依赖，并不是从个人身上产生的，而是从这样的制度中产生的。
从前，正是这些社区首长独自选出了出席邦议会的议员；而各委员会成员中较大的一部分，出自文书吏这一阶层。
在格里辛格的意见书 S. 72 处说：「对文书吏机构的改进，乃至彻底的改造，必定会在等级议会的代表们那里遇到最大的反对者；因为这些代表自己多半就是文书吏，或者至少对文书吏有影响；每一项主要的改进都同他们自己的利益最明显地相抵触。」——说到这里，一切都已说尽了。
然而，那些从早先的邦议会与等级委员会那里作为「曾经有过」的东西、作为一段往事而出现的东西，难道不也是一场关系——正如这个等级会议自身的历史一样吗？它为扫除这样一座奥吉亚斯的牛圈做过什么有效的事吗？它难道不曾在自己的肠子里逞威吗？
福斯特纳先生一再重复的努力——他并不因它们的拖延而厌倦——可曾使得在一年零一天之后，连委员会的一份报告都没有能够产生？更不用说曾经有过一次商议、乃至一项决议被付诸这件事了？136)

en: It is characteristic that the complaints and grievances came almost only from New Württemberg, as if Old Württemberg had been so entangled in such a condition, actively and passively, that it had no consciousness and feeling, or rather only on the one side the feeling of resigned desperation and on the other only a privileged conscience entirely secured in the good old guaranteed rights! - It may have contributed its share that the old Württemberg scribal men, who had to be needed above all as experienced men in the trade in the new territory, thereabouts made themselves at home in a conquered land more angrily than at home.

But thus the new countrymen found themselves badly served, who had grown up and been formed in the habit of the old Württemberg law and of this so praised constitution; and equally badly served they found this old law and this old constitution.
zh: 一个值得注意的特点是：那些控诉与陈情几乎全来自新符腾堡，仿佛老符腾堡在那样一种状态中——无论主动还是被动——陷得如此之深，以致它既没有意识与感受，或者说在一边只有听天由命的绝望，在另一边只有一个在那些良好的、古老的、受到保障的权利中完全安全无虞的特权良知！——这或许也有份儿：新地区最需要的正是那些行家里手的老符腾堡文书吏，而他们在那里——如同在被征服的国土上——比起在自己家里来更闹腾地安顿了下来。
然而，这些在老符腾堡的法与那部备受称颂的宪法的习惯中长大、成长起来的新同乡，如此看来并没有得到好处的；他们同样也没有从这部旧法与这部旧宪法那里得到好处。

en: But one could make a reproach of the ministry for having summoned an assembly of the estates whose elements it must have known, and for having advised the king no further than to add to those changes which he had made in the upper storeys of the state the fact that he had carried out the regeneration of the unhappy constitutional condition of the general mass of the people.

As long as this peculiar to Württemberg, civic aristocracy existed, which drew episcopal revenues as dues by means of writing and exercised a general power over the municipalities, their heads and private persons; as long as these heads and municipalities were not torn from the claws of this privileged caste, this element of ethical and intellectual stagnation which ensnares concepts like the purse of the mass of the people had not been destroyed, no true concept of right, freedom and constitution could take root, and the ministry could expect nothing other than that a large part of the elected deputies would emerge from this element.
zh: 不过，人们倒是可以指责各部：它召集了一个——其成分它必定是了解的——等级会议，却不曾进一步劝国王：在他在国家上层所作的那些变革之外，再补上一项：他已经促成了那不幸的、全体民众之宪法状态的重建。
只要这个符腾堡所特有的市民贵族还存在——它以书写为手段，把主教辖区的收入当作贡赋攫取，并对自治市、其首长与私人实行一种普遍的权力；只要这些首长与自治市还没有从这个特权等级的爪子里被撕扯出来；只要那种把「人民的钱袋」这类概念也缠裹进去的伦理与智识上的败坏成分还没有被摧毁——那么，关于权利、自由与宪法的任何真实概念就都扎不下根；各部也就只能指望：从当选的议员中将有相当大的一部分出自这一成分。

en: It could seem brilliant that the king, first among the German princes, gave his people estates according to an organisation which was to make them into representatives of the rights not of a class but of the people themselves, which could thereby tear the estates' constitution out of the indifference and estrangement, yes contempt, of the people towards it, into which the earlier German estates had sunk.137) Old Württemberg had no considerable nobility of its own; on the contrary, that less conspicuous but more oppressive aristocracy had established itself.

But as long as these fetters of the people had not been broken, no representation could emerge which belonged to it; and indispensable as it is for the concept of a monarchical state that there should be estates in it, it would be better even to have none at all than to put up with the continuance of those privileges, that oppression, deception and dulling-down of the people; and it would be better still to have estates which are not the representatives of the privileges of this aristocracy. - The ministry could equally know the principles of the other aristocracy, into which Württemberg had just been incorporated or, according to the sense of a part of them, was still to be incorporated.

It had to foresee that this class would begin by reserving its rights to itself - rights which in that indefiniteness leave it undecided what relation this estate had in the state, and which in their old extent contradict every state organism. - It has shown itself in most cases of great political movement that prince and people have been of one mind and one will, but that a middle estate has far too often, as in France the nobility and the clergy, so in Württemberg that nobility and the civic aristocracy of the scribal business, instead of forming the bond between the two as is its destiny, stiffened itself into privileges and monopolies and hindered, nay made null, the realization of the principles of rational law and the general good.

Through the position which belongs to the middle estate in general, of constituting the intelligence of a people and of handling directly both its rights and its duties, it is able, when it instead defends its own privileges against the people, to delude the people into the belief that it places itself on the side of its enemy.

Then arises the spectacle as disgusting as it is sad: that an injustice which for a hundred years was called right, was regarded as such and brought the people to desperation, is supported by the people themselves who have been deceived by this name.
zh: 看上去可以很光辉：国王在德国的诸侯中首先给了自己的人民一个等级议会，其组织方式将使他们成为——不是某一阶层的、而是人民本身的——权利的代表；这个措施本可以把他们从人民对等级议会的漠不关心与疏离、甚至轻蔑中拉出来，而早期的德国等级议会正是沉沦在这种态度里的。137) 老符腾堡并没有一个显赫的贵族；相反盘踞在那里的，是那种更不显眼、却更为压迫人的贵族。
然而，只要这些束缚人民的锁链还没有被打破，就不可能产生出一种真正属于人民的代表制；而对君主制国家这一概念来说，设有等级议会固然不可或缺，但与其容忍那些特权、那种对人民的压迫、欺骗与麻木继续存在，宁可干脆一个也不要；当然更宁可有这样一些等级议会：它们不是这一贵族特权的代表。——各部同样也清楚那另一种贵族的原则；符腾堡刚刚被并入这种贵族，或者按照其中一部分人的意思，本来也应当被并入这种贵族。

各部必定预见到：这一阶层会以此为开端，把自己的权利先行保留下来——这些权利处在那种不确定的状态中，使人无法判定这一阶层在国家里究竟处于何种关系，而这些权利按其原有的范围又与任何国家机体相抵触。——在大多数重大的政治变动中都显现出：君主与人民原是同一条心、同一个意愿的；可是中间阶层却常常——如在法国是贵族与教士，在符腾堡则是那个贵族与文书吏衙门的市民贵族——不去充当两者之间的纽带（这本该是它的天职），反而僵化于特权与垄断之中，阻碍乃至摧毁理性法与普遍福利之原则的实现。
中间阶层本来的位置，是充当一个民族的理智、直接掌管这个民族的权利与义务；而当它转而为维护自己的特权去与人民抗衡时，它就有本事使人民产生一种错觉，以为它站到了自己敌人的那一边。
于是就出现了这样一幕既令人作呕又令人悲哀的场面：一桩被称作「权利」达一百年、被当成权利、并把人民逼到绝望的不义之徒，竟由那个被这个名称骗了的人民自己来支持。

en: Now that the principles, the spirit and the interests of this assembly have made themselves sufficiently evident from what has so far been related, the further history, which is only a dry sequence of that, has less interest and can be summarised more briefly.
zh: 既然从这个等级会议的各项原则、精神与利益——从已经讲述的内容中——已经看得够清楚了，那么此后的历史（它不过是前者的干巴巴的继续）就少了一些趣味，也可以更简短地概括。

en: In the course of the historical account we have lingered at the fact that on 26 June the estates did not enter upon giving the form of an agreement to that which in the important royal concessions was acceptable to them, by which the points likewise acceptable from the royal constitution could have been connected, but rather held themselves in the position of complete dissatisfaction.
It is original in this, but quite in the style of the course so far (IX.

Abt., S. 3), that in the following sitting, after the resolution taken, the examination of the royal resolutions was now brought up in an essay by a single member, Dr Weishaar, and a committee was appointed to examine this essay.
This committee reported on 28 June, but made no mention at all of an examination and of the findings of this essay; it only proposed to communicate it to the royal negotiating commissioners.

This resolution of 28 June also appears in the main address, although this is dated 26 June; and on the 28th the resolution taken on the 26th, in which the high guarantors of the old Württemberg constitution, namely the three powers Prussia, England and Denmark, are mentioned, is withdrawn. - On 21. July the expected royal resolution took place (XX.

Abt., S. 13), the adjournment of the assembly from 26 July, with the motive that the land's grievances presented to the king must be of far greater importance than the present discussions about constitutional subjects, and that he was minded to subject those to a strict examination and investigation by the ministries and authorities, - that, since the estates had exhausted in their submitted essays everything which they could possibly in the case bring to the king, there was no subject which presented itself as suitable for a deliberation with the assembly.

Further, the king instructed them to leave plenipotentiaries behind for the continuation of the negotiation and to instruct them so that an agreement could be looked forward to. - One will have to admit that this resolution, with regard to the two subjects at hand, was in accordance with the nature of the situation.
zh: 在叙述历史的途中，我们曾停留在这样一点上：6 月 26 日，等级议会并不去把国王那些重要让步中对他们而言可以接受的内容，与同样出自王家宪法、也可以接受的那些条款结合起来，从而赋予它一份协议的形态；他们反而保持了一种全然不满的姿态。
这一点颇具独创性，不过完全合乎此前一路的笔调（《文件补编》 IX.
，《文件补编》 S. 3），即：在随后一次会议中，经过决议之后，对国王各项决议的审查终于由某一位议员——魏斯哈尔博士先生——的一篇文章提了出来，并且还任命了一个委员会来审查这篇文章。
这个委员会于 6 月 28 日作了汇报，却对这篇文章的审查与结果只字未提，只是提议把它转交给国王的谈判专员。
6 月 28 日的这一决议也出现在那份主要呈文中——尽管那份呈文的日期是 6 月 26 日；而在 28 日，那一项于 26 日作出的、提到老符腾堡宪法的高位保证国（即普鲁士、英格兰与丹麦三个国家）的决议，又被撤销了。——7 月 21. 日，可以预料的王家决议随之作出（《文件补编》 XX.
，《文件补编》 S. 13），即自 7 月 26 日起休会，理由是：呈交国王的那些土地陈情必定比眼下这些关于宪法事项的争论重要得多，而国王意欲把那些陈情交由各部与各机关作严格审查与调查；——并且，既然等级议会已在所呈交的文章中把他们可能呈给国王的一切都发挥殆尽，那么便不存在任何适合与等级会议共同商议的议题。
此外，国王还指令他们留下全权代表以继续谈判，并训令他们如此行事，以期能够望见一份协议的达成。——人们不得不承认：就眼前这两项事务而言，这一决议是合乎事态的。

en: The estates, on the contrary, declared in their address of 24 July (X. Abt., S. 15) that what lay at heart for them was by no means so much the grievances as the constitution; that they had been placed in the greatest sorrow by the royal resolution, since they were to be adjourned before they could bring the people any consolation, any reassurance.

Besides this denial that the king had conceded so much which was of importance to them themselves but in truth as good as everything essential, they added the announcement that they had empowered a committee of 25 members under the chairmanship of the former president of the assembly, which was to carry on the comparison negotiations and in general to look after the interest of the land.

For the rest, they can give no other instruction than that which they have received from the people and carry in their hearts; they further reserve to themselves the ratification of the negotiations. - Thus the way was now on the way, namely on the part of the estates, to a committee of the old style, to a committee empowered to look after the interest of the land in general.
The king saved his people from this and rescued the estates against their will and against themselves.

The ridiculousness of the estates' motion was rejected by a resolution of 26 July (X. Abt., S. 50) on the ground that it was incompatible with the concept of an adjournment that a collegium representing the whole assembly should remain behind. - But with the notions of these estates, as has been seen in abundance, much was compatible that is not compatible with the concept. - They shall further leave plenipotentiaries in the same number as their previous negotiating commissioners. - In the same sitting, that of 26 July, in which this royal resolution was read out, Mr Bolley developed in a votum scriptum that the assembly could in no respect leave behind only four plenipotentiaries.

Then the dispatching of a deputation to the king, which was to repeat the previous requests orally, was proposed; but it was rejected, because such a deputation would achieve as little as the previous written submissions, because it would furthermore be against the old norms, - because a regent has so many means in his hands, to reject those who come before him with apparent shame, so that this act could be connected with unpleasantnesses for the assembly. - Was it perhaps afraid that its deputation would be thrashed? - While the committee was busy drafting the address, in this distress the rest of the assembly had addresses read out, partly from far distant towns and their districts, dated the previous day, presented on the 26th 'per Estafette' (by courier), and drawn up in the sense of the assembly.
Of other addresses of a different content which had not yet come up for reading, only the long list was presented, though without stating the date of their drafting and presentation.

Among other essays there was also read one 'desired by several members' concerning the daily allowances - refused to them by the official guardians. - In an earlier sitting it had been noted that the members refused to accept their daily allowances from the state treasury and demanded them from the municipal treasuries, whose administrators, as it seems, were not all willing to make this unjustified payment.
zh: 等级议会却在 7 月 24 日的呈文中（《文件补编》 X, S. 15）申明：他们所在意的与其说是那些陈情，倒不如说是宪法；国王的决议使他们陷入极大的悲哀，因为在能够给人民带来任何安慰、任何宽慰之前，他们竟要被休会。
除了这番否认——否认国王所承认的那么多东西对他们自己原本至关重要，而实际上却几乎是全部重要之物——他们还附上一项声明：他们已经授权一个由 25 名成员组成、由历任议会议长主持的委员会，由它去进行协商性的谈判，并全面照料土地的利益。
此外，他们所能给出的训令，无非是人民给他们的、他们记在心里的那一份；他们还把对谈判的批准权保留在自己手里。——于是，在等级议会这一边，道路就此通向一个旧式的委员会——一个被授权全面照料土地利益的委员会。
国王使人民免于此难；他不顾等级议会的意愿、并且是针对他们自己，把他们解救了出来。

7 月 26 日的一项决议以这样一条理由驳回了等级议会这项提议的荒谬（《文件补编》 X, S. 50）：即：让一个代表全体会议的团体留了下来，这与休会这一概念不相容。——但是，正如人们已经充分看到的，这些等级议会的种种想法倒也容得下许多与这一概念并不相容的东西。——他们还应当留下全权代表，人数与此前其谈判专员相同。——就在宣读这道王家决议的同一次会议——7 月 26 日——上，博莱先生以一份书面意见（votum scriptum）论述说：等级会议无论如何都不能只留下四名全权代表。

接着有人提议派遣一个代表团去见国王、口头重申此前的各项请求；但这一提议被驳回了：这样的代表团所能成就的，不会比此前那些书面陈情更多；而且它还会违反旧有的规矩；——因为一位摄政者手中掌握着这样多的手段，足以把那些走到他面前的人带着表面的羞惭拒之门外，从而使这一举动给等级会议招来不便。——它或许是担心自己的代表团会被痛打一顿？——就在委员会忙于起草呈文之际，在这危难之中，其余的等级会议则让人宣读了一些呈文，其中一部分来自十分遥远的城市及其辖区；这些呈文日期写在前一天，于 26 日以「per Estafette」（快报）送到，并且是按等级会议的旨意拟成的。
另一些内容不同、尚未宣读的呈文，则只呈交了一份长长的清单——却没有说明这些呈文拟就与呈递的日期。
此外，在其他文章中还宣读了一份「由若干成员所期望的」文件，内容是关于那些——被事务监督官拒绝发给他们的——津贴。——因为在更早的一次会议上就曾记载：议员们拒绝从国库领取自己的津贴，而改向各自治市的市库索取；而这些市库的管理者，看来并非人人都情愿作这项不正当的支付。

en: The address now resolved upon by the assembly remains at its previous demand and closes, amid much pathos, with the usual broad self-praise and self-testimony of its conscience, and that it had done nothing but its duty, that it had received from the people the most moving proofs of gratitude for this and from all Germany proofs of respect, etc. - The king had summoned it, had given the charter, whose leading features have been considered above, had consented to the further concessions and, regardless of the ignominious replies of the assembly to the same, had permitted the continuation of the negotiation set up and begun; the sitting together of the assembly itself was without any object; to it were reserved both the instruction of its plenipotentiaries and the ratification of what had been negotiated.

Nevertheless of all this the authors of the address and the assembly unanimous with them did not blush to say to the king that, if he did not consent to the transfer of the rights of the estates to a committee, they must be convinced that his intention was that the people should receive no constitution at all. - Now the assembly still had recourse to the last expedient in this emergency, in which everything seemed to be at stake, - namely to turn to the guarantors. - Mr Bolley expressed himself on this (Abt. X, S. 37) to the effect that, if the king did not comply with the wishes of the address, not only every possibility of addressing themselves to the Bundestag as an assembly of the estates would fall away, but also that there would not be much left to lose for the matter itself. - One may find it strange enough how the assembly could plunge itself into such a fever and sultry heat; its exaggeration, where the business was a quite simple one, could have no purpose other than to make the worst intentions on the king's side, the danger of the loss of the matter, credible; and that matter was the reduction of the estates to an old committee.
zh: 等级会议此刻议决的这份呈文仍停留在它先前的要求上，并且在大量浮夸之中以惯常的宽泛自夸与「向自己良心作的证词」收尾：说自己所做的无非是职责，说自己为此从人民那里得到了最令人感动的感激之证、从整个德意志得到了敬重之证，等等。——国王召集了它，颁布了宪章（其基本轮廓上面已经考察过），同意作出新的让步，并且不管等级会议对这些让步所作的卑劣答复，依然允许那场已经布置并开始的谈判继续下去；等级会议本身的集会已毫无对象；对它保留的，是对其全权代表的训令，以及对谈判结果的批准。

尽管有这一切，呈文的作者们以及与他们意见一致的等级会议仍然不羞于对国王说：如果他不肯同意把等级议会的权利移交给一个委员会，他们就必须相信，他的意图是让人民根本得不到一部宪法。——在这场什么都似乎岌岌可危的危难中，等级会议仍旧抓住最后一件手段——也就是去求助于保证国。——博莱先生就这一点表达得（《文件补编》 X, S. 37）是这样的：如果国王不答应呈文中的愿望，那么，不仅作为等级会议去联邦议会的可能性将完全消失，而且这件事本身也没有多少可损失的了。——人们不妨觉得奇怪：等级会议怎么竟会把自己投入这样一场热病与闷热之中；在一件本来十分简单的事情上，它的过火，其目的不可能不是要让国王方面最坏的意图——即这件事要丧失的可能——显得可信；而这件事就是：把等级议会缩减为一个旧式委员会。

en: But as for the invocation of the guarantors of the old constitution, there was only this lacking: that the estates should have addressed letters to a diet at Regensburg and an imperial supreme court at Vienna.

They invoked the guarantee of powers which had only just now, in Vienna, in common with the others, newly consolidated the dissolution of the German empire and the elevation of the Duchy of Württemberg into a state, which had reasonably stipulated for the new German states estates' constitutions in general, not the old ones - and had thereby laid in this article the only conceivable guarantee for a new German state, should such a thing be necessary -, yes which had not even laid upon the French nation, whose king they had just restored to his throne for the second time, the shame of a guarantee of their charter, much less that this people should have called upon them to this last humiliation of itself. - And as is self-evident, the Württemberg estates never received an answer to their letters to those three powers.
zh: 不过说到对旧宪法保证国的呼吁，所缺的只有一件事：等级议会还没有分别致函于雷根斯堡的帝国议会与维也纳的帝国最高法院。

他们求助于这样一些大国的保证：这些大国刚刚在维也纳，与其余诸国一道，重新巩固了德意志帝国的解体以及符腾堡公国上升为一个国家；它们明智地为新的德意志诸国规定了一般性的等级议会宪法，而不是旧的宪法；——并且在这个条款中为新的德意志国家放置了那唯一可以想象的保证（如果确实需要这样一项保证的话）；——它们甚至连让法国民族——那个它们刚刚第二次扶上王位的国王的民族——蒙受为其宪章提供保证的耻辱都没有做，就更不用说这个民族会要求它们来承受这种对自身的最后屈辱了。——而且不言而喻，符腾堡等级议会给他们致那三个大国的信，从来没有收到过任何答复。

en: The king made the assembly aware, in a decree of 27 July, of the inexplicable nature of their conduct, and left it to them, if it should serve their reassurance, to appoint a double or triple number of deputies; he postponed the date of the adjournment to the 28th, in order to give the assembly once more time for reflection.

On the 28th it still produced a broad address like the previous ones, in a tone of self-righteous hatred and bitter resentment, which contrasted very sharply with the tone of dignified bearing, of simplicity that remained calm, and of restriction to the essential in the royal resolutions; - the expression at the close of the address, that by this adjournment an incurable split had been brought about between the king and the land, an assembly of the estates would never have permitted itself. - It now dispersed.
zh: 国王在一道 7 月 27 日的敕令中让等级议会明白他们行为举动的不可理解之处，并把事情留给他们：如果这能使他们安心，就可以任命双倍或三倍的议员；他把休会的期限推迟到 28. 日，为的是再给等级会议一次从容思考的时间。
28 日，它又炮制了一份与前几份同样宽泛的呈文，语调是那种自以为是的憎恨与恶毒的怨愤；这与王家决议中那种庄重的姿态、那种沉静的简约、那种专注于要旨的语调形成了极为强烈的对照；——至于呈文末尾那句「此次休会在国王与土地之间造成了一道无法愈合的裂痕」，一个等级会议是绝不会容许自己说出口的。——于是它散会了。

en: This evil bitterness, should it have had a share in the moving proofs of the people's gratitude (among others at a night-time music in one of the last sittings)?
One might have thought that only the mob found pleasure in it and could have had its self-feeling in it.

As for the king, he was unable not to summon the estates again; rather, he refuted their conduct - their not holding to the matter and to his declared will, but above all to their own imputations of intentions - by summoning them again on 16 October of the same year.

If the ministry had already found it extremely improbable before the first summoning that with such material as was available for an assembly of the estates nothing fruitful was to be achieved, then after the experience so far it could consider itself convinced of the impossibility and, before the whole world, justified if it did not summon them again.

Such a sitting together, however, is always of infinite importance for the political education which a people and its leaders need, a people which had hitherto lived in political nullity and whose education was not, as with a people still free of prejudice, to begin quite from the front, but which was also entangled in the hard fetters of an oppressive aristocracy, in an inner constitution built upon that, and in the lack and the distortedness of concepts about state and rights of freedom, or rather in words.

Against such concepts, which, as has been seen, were so closely bound up with the fixed and secure interest of the ruling caste, no direct combat can be entered into with concepts, nor can any direct effect from it be expected; the indirect effect is all the more certain, though unobtrusive, that such sense is given room to struggle with itself and to bring itself to light.
The first effect upon the public is that it soon, as such distorted content develops further, no longer understands anything of it and of its defence.

One consequence, the disclosure of the rights of the scribal institution, and thereby a more correct and more widespread consciousness of where a lasting source of oppression lies - the characters and actions of the regents as well as the circumstances are only something transient in comparison -, has been considered, and an effect at least of formal education will show itself further.

Since under those suppositions it could not and had not succeeded in introducing the constitution a priori, there was only this left: to set the estates on the path of their education through themselves - a path to which people indeed also have a right; it does the prince and his ministry honour to be confident that it, even though it started from the opposite standpoint, necessarily brings them unconsciously nearer to the rational, and has opened this path.
zh: 这种恶毒的怨愤——它是否也参与了人民那些令人感动的感激之证（在最后几次会议中的一次夜乐会上就有这样的场面）呢？
人们本可以说，只有那群粗野之徒才从中得到乐趣，才在这其中感到自尊。
至于国王，他无法不再次召集等级议会；恰恰相反，他用以下办法驳倒了他们的行为——即他们不肯以事情本身和他所宣布的意愿为准，反而主要听命于自己对他人动机的种种猜度——他在同年 10 月 16 日再次召集了他们。
如果各部在第一次召集时就已认定：拿这样一些材料去凑一个等级议会，绝不可能办成什么有成效的事，那么根据迄今为止的经验，它完全可以确信事情无从办起，并且在全世界面前为自己不再次召集他们而辩护。
不过，这样一次集会，对于一个民族及其领导人所需的政治教育来说，永远具有无穷的重要；这个民族迄今一直生活在政治上的空无之中；它的教育并不像对一个尚无偏见的民族那样，只是完全从头开始；它还被一个压迫性的贵族所铸成的坚硬锁链、建立在这种贵族之上的内在宪法、以及对于国家权利与自由权利这些概念的匮乏与畸形——或者不如说，被这些概念的空话——牢牢缠住。
对于这样一些概念——正如人们所见，它们与统治阶层的既得而稳固的利益结合得如此紧密——是无法用概念与之正面交锋的，也无法期待由此产生任何直接的效果；而其间接效果则更加可靠，虽然不显著：那就是给这样的意识留出空间，让它与自己搏斗，并显露自己。
对公众的最初影响是：随着这种扭曲的内容进一步发展，公众很快就不再理解它，也不再理解对它的辩护。
有一项后果已经得到考察：揭露文书吏机构的权利；由此也就产生了一种更为正确、更为普及的认识——认识到一个持久的压迫之源在哪里；相比之下，统治者的品行与行为以及具体情势不过都是些转瞬即逝的东西。——而至少在形式教养方面的效果，今后还会显现出来。
既然在那些前提之下，宪法不可能被先验地（a priori）引入、事实上也没有被引入，那么剩下的就只有一件事：把等级议会放到那条由他们自己教育自己的道路上去——这条路，人们当然也有权去走；而对君主和他的各部来说，值得称道的是，他们确信：这条路虽然是从相反的出发点开始的，却必然会在无意之中把人们带得离理性更近，并且已经把这条路为他们打开了。

en: In the royal decree of 16 October 1815 (XI.

Abt., S. 26), by which the new session was opened, the standpoint of the negotiations is now determined in the following clear manner: that the estates hold that the principle of the legal claim of Old and New Württemberg upon the old constitution must first be established; the king would have to declare himself bound by it to transfer also what he considers faulty in Old Württemberg to New Württemberg; to this he could not, according to his most grounded conviction, declare himself bound.

Even if he were convinced that the claim of Old Württemberg upon its former state of law was still binding for him, which is not the case, he could easily let himself be reconciled to its restoration, if it were a matter of the old land alone; nor is he minded not to take into account the former legal relations of the newly acquired parts of the land.

But it could not be a matter of setting up each of the so different parts of the kingdom according to its own peculiar norms, but of bringing about a constitution equally appropriate to the old and the new conditions through a common agreement. - Further, in this opening there was no longer any talk of the royal constitution; rather, the changes which the king reserved to himself as necessary for the welfare of the state are mentioned only in individual determinations and are to be made good in the way of negotiation.
He further declared that of the old constitution what could in any way be reconciled with the present time and with a good state administration was to be retained.

The recognition of the old principle of law in its whole extent was in itself useless and contrary to the nature of the matter, but it exhausted the truth through the recognition that everything usable from the old constitution was to be retained.
zh: 在 1815 年 10 月 16 日的王家敕令中（《文件补编》 XI.
，《文件补编》 S. 26），——新的会期即以此开幕——谈判的立场如今以下列明确的方式被确定了：等级议会主张，老符腾堡与新符腾堡对旧宪法所提出的法权要求的原则必须首先得到确定；国王将不得不因此声明自己承担义务，把他在老符腾堡方面认为有缺陷的东西也转移到新符腾堡方面去；而依他最坚决的确信，他不能就这一点承担义务。
即便他确信老符腾堡对其旧有法权状态的要求对他仍然有约束力——事实并非如此——他也可以轻易同意恢复它，只要这单单是老领地的事情；他也无意不去顾及新取得各地区的旧有法权关系。
但问题不可能在于：把王国中如此不同的各部分各自按照其特有的规范加以设置；而在于通过共同的协议，制定出一部同样切合旧有与新有情势的宪法。——此外，在这一开场白中，已经不再谈什么王家宪法了；国王作为国家福利所必需而保留的种种改变，只被点名了若干具体条款，并且将通过谈判的途径使其成立。
他还声明：旧宪法中凡是能够与当今的时代以及一种良好的国家行政相协调的部分，都将予以保留。
在全部范围内承认旧法权原则，就其本身而言既无用又违背事情的本性；但通过承认旧宪法中一切可用的东西都将予以保留，它也就穷尽了真实。

en: As for the composition of the estates, as it appears at their re-opening, before we go further: most of those who led the viril votes had also joined and made their appearance, partly in person - among them six princes -, partly by transferring their votes to those present.

Twelve of the nobility had already, in an address of 3. May (Abt. IV, S. 141 ff.), laid before the assembly of the estates the point on which they wished to limit their expectations and wishes with regard to the privileges which should remain to them from their former position in the new state organism.
These demands, moderate in their content and, what is equally important, stated in detail and determinately, are also drafted in an open, frank but corresponding tone.
The legal counsellor Griesinger did indeed read on 6 June (VI.

Abt., S. 113) a report entrusted to him concerning that address, but because this matter would have been a matter of substance, the assembly did not come to any deliberation on it, much less to any resolution. - On 26 June (X. Abt., S. 24) the rest of the nobility of the kingdom joined that address.

Likewise on the same day (X. Abt., S. 26) another part of the standesherren, who had expected (I. Abt., S. 15) the results of the Vienna Congress concerning their constitutional-legal relations and consistently wanted to take no part in the estates' deliberations, now that that congress was concluded, as also the Prince of Öttingen-Wallerstein, declared themselves willing to take part, - with reference to the rights determined for them by the federal act, namely to be the first standesherren in the states in which their possessions lie, or to the rights and powers that may further accrue to them in the future. - Several standesherren, however, had not appeared even this time.
Several newly elected members also appear in place of former ones who had laid down their posts as deputies.

It seems that this laying down of posts as well as the electing of new deputies raised no objection and that the ministry allowed it to happen, although nothing about it was determined in the royal charter of the constitution.

There was in any case also still lacking one thing essential for every assembly, a set of rules; thus one sees the assembly in this new first sitting, where such princely splendour entered it, make for its mark of respect the same gesture which, as mentioned above, in the very first had meant the voting on its resolution. - Now, so much indeterminacy as still lay in the relation of the standesherren to the state and to an assembly of the estates, it could suffice that they now acknowledged themselves as standesherren of the kingdom, - for an assembly which itself still was and remained in quite the same indeterminacy.
If it had been possible for it to enter into the substance of constitutional matters, that inadequacy would soon have come to light.
zh: 在我们继续往下走之前，先看等级议会重新开会时的构成：大多数拥有个人表决权的等级代表也加入并出席了会议——其中有六位诸侯——其余则是把自己的选票转交在场者代为行使。
贵族中有十二人早在 5 月 3. 日的一份呈文中（《文件补编》 IV, S. 141 ff.）就已向等级会议表明：他们把自己的期待与愿望——就其在新国家机体中从原有地位上应当保留下来的那些特权而言——限定在这一点上。
这些在内容上有所节制、并且同样重要的是写得细致而明确的各项要求，其行文也是坦率、直白而又与内容相称的。
法务顾问格里辛格确曾于 6 月 6 日宣读（「《文件补编》 VI.
，《文件补编》 S. 113）一份受他委托就那份呈词所作的报告；但由于这件事本会是一件有实质内容的事，等级会议并未就此进行任何商议，更不用说作出决议了。——王国的其余贵族于 6 月 26 日（《文件补编》 X, S. 24）也在这份呈词上联署。

同样在这同一天（《文件补编》 X, S. 26），另一部分等级领主——他们原指望（《文件补编》 I, S. 15）维也纳会议就其国家法权关系作出结果，因而一贯不打算参与等级议会的审议——如今既然那场会议已经结束，便像厄廷根－瓦勒施泰因亲王殿下一样，声明愿意参与；——他们所依据的是《联邦法案》为他们确定的权利，即在他们的领地所在的那些国家中充当第一等等级领主的权利，或是日后可能进一步归之于他们的权利与权限。——不过，好几位等级领主这一次也仍然没有出席。
此外，若干新当选的成员也出现在原先那些已辞去议员职位的人的位置上。
看来，这些职位的辞让以及新议员的选举都没有引起异议，而各部也就任其发生了——尽管王家宪法文书中并没有就此作出任何规定。

总之，还缺少每一场会议都不可或缺的一样东西：一套议事规则；于是人们看到，在这次崭新的首次会议上——当这样的王公排场进入其中时——等级会议为了表示敬意，采用了与最初那次相同的姿态；正如前面提到的，在最初那次，这一姿态意味着对自身决议的表决。——既然等级领主与国家、与等级议会之间的关系中仍包含着这么多不确定，那么他们如今承认自己是符腾堡王国的等级领主，也就够了；——对于一个自身仍旧完全处在同样不确定之中的会议来说，这就够了。
倘若它有可能就宪法的实质内容有所涉入，那么那种不充分很快就会显露出来。

en: In the resolution of 16 October the king had further called upon the estates to instruct their plenipotentiaries, who already existed, for the negotiations in such a way that a comparison valid for the whole could be concluded.
The estates replied with an address of twelve small-print sheets (XI.
Abt., S. 263-286), for the thorough elaboration of which the assembly thanked Mr Bolley.

It repeats the old views in the customary manner; there is no need to extract anything from it, except this: that on S. 269 it says: even a superficial acquaintance with the Württemberg constitution gives the conviction that it constitutes a self-existing, closed totality; - one may grant this sentence in one sense, but hardly this much, for even a merely superficial acquaintance is already far too much for such a conviction or rather judgement. - It further says among other things that the estates cannot admit that the people's history were to be torn from them and all earlier fundamental laws made into antiquities; - one might rather ask whether a people which was not an independent state but only a part of a people has really had a history at all, whether a people does not indeed first receive a history when it becomes a state. - That in this address the estates declare themselves unable to specify the rights of the Württemberg subjects because the old land archive is still withheld from them has been mentioned above, - as if it were a matter of the constitution as such to have a codex of the penal and civil law, etc., and as if the royal charter of the constitution had no longer given effect to any of these rights! - The simple and monotonous closing plea is that the king solemnly acknowledge the old Württemberg constitution as a rule valid for the whole kingdom, with the single reservation of such modifications as are necessary or expedient by mutual acknowledgement.
zh: 国王在 10 月 16 日的决议中曾再次要求等级议会：就谈判一事，给他们早已存在的全权代表下达训令，以便达成一份对整体有效的协议。
等级议会则以一份十二张小开印本的呈文答复（《文件补编》 XI.
，《文件补编》 S. 263-286），等级议会为这份呈文的精心起草向博莱先生致谢。

它照例重复那些旧有的见解；不必从中摘录什么，只需指出这一点：S. 269 处说，即使对符腾堡宪法只是浮面的了解，也足以令人确信：它构成一个自足封闭的整体；——这句话在某种意义上可以承认，但连这一点也勉强，因为即便只是浮面的了解，对于这样一种确信、或者更确切地说对于这样一种判断来说，也已经远远够了。——此外其中还说，等级议会不能承认人民的历史会被夺走、早先的各项基本法条会被变成陈旧之物；——人们反倒可以问：一个不是独立国家、而只是某个民族的一部分的民族，究竟是否有过自己的历史；一个民族是否恰恰要到成为一个国家的时候才获得一部历史。——等级议会在这份呈文中宣称自己无法列举符腾堡臣民的权利，因为旧有的土地档案馆仍然不让他们过目——这一点上面已经提到过；——仿佛在宪法本身的问题上，所关紧要的是一部刑民法典之类的东西，仿佛王家的宪法文书已经不再让这些权利中的任何一项发生效力似的！——那个简单而单调的结语是：请求国王庄严承认老符腾堡宪法为一条对整个王国有效的规则，只保留这样一项保留：按照双方共同认可，那些必要的或适宜的修改。

en: The estates had at first conceded only those modifications of the old Württemberg constitution which related to the incorporation of the nobility and the community of rights of Protestants and Catholics; according to their address, the 'sanction' now to be established should only be added to the chaos of the old land laws which has been recounted above.

If it should concern only those two subjects, it would still have been the same untenable conception, or rather the wholly empty illusion, to want to let the old constitution enter in - the old Württemberg constitution, indeed, with the ignoring and suppression of all the claims of the newly Württemberg parts of the country to their peculiar rights - under the completely changed position of the kingdom towards the duchy.

But just as that agreement to be concluded was to contain more - and the nature of the matter would have brought this about of itself, and the plea of the address speaks of it in more general terms -, so the opposition between the king's declared will and the estates' demand is determined by the question whether the royal constitution with the concession that modifications of it are to be agreed upon, or the old Württemberg constitution with the same concession, is to be taken as the basis.

If in diplomatic negotiations it should happen that one party proposed the taking as a basis of its proposition with the concession of further modifications to be agreed upon, and the other party had demanded the same, then, since the matter is quite the same, the wiser one would give way according to the proverb.
zh: 等级议会起初只承认了老符腾堡宪法中那些涉及贵族的并入、以及新教徒与天主教徒权利一律平等的修改；按照他们的呈文，如今所应确立的「批准」不过是在上面已经叙述过的那些旧土地法制的混乱之上再添一笔罢了。
倘若它只涉及那两项事务，那么仍旧是那副站不住脚的想法、或者更确切地说那场完全空洞的幻想：想让旧宪法——就是那部老符腾堡宪法，并且是撇开并压制新符腾堡各地区对自身固有权利的一切要求——在王国对公国关系已经完全改变了的局势之下重新登台。
但是，正如那份有待缔结的协议本应包含更多内容——事情的本性自会导向这一点，而呈文中的请求也是用更一般的方式谈到它——那么国王的意愿与等级议会的要求之间的对立，就取决于这样一个问题：是以王家宪法为基线、同时承认对它还可以商定出某些修改，还是以老符腾堡宪法为基线、作出同样的让步。
如果在外交谈判中，一方提出以其提案为基线、同时让步说还可以就进一步的修改达成协议，而另一方也提出同样的要求，那么——既然事情完全一样——按照那句谚语，更明智的那一方就会退让。

en: In the royal rescript of 13. November, which finally, though not on the matter itself, yet on the course of the estates' so far libelling brought a decision, there was an entry into the essential legal assertions of the estates, especially of the incorporation, and in a special appendix their shallowness was shown up, the principal standpoint was repeated, that what was at stake was a state constitution by which the new and old lands would be united into a constitutional-legal totality.

The king declares that he could not consent to a merely general acknowledgement of the old land treaties without a detailed statement of their content, since the German imperial constitution has been abrogated, and where there is uncertainty of law there are no longer any judges either.

In the first place a complete and clear development of this content, scattered in many charters and often doubtful, would be indispensable, so that the constitutional determinations should no longer be the exclusive property of a few (of the old committee lords, perhaps not even of all of them and chiefly only of their legal counsellors), but rather become the common possession of the people. - In the unhappy case that a comparison about a common constitution should not come about and the estates should further refuse to enter into negotiations for one, the king would be determined to introduce in his hereditary land the traditional representation, and in his new lands on the other hand a constitution founded on a true national representation, with regard to their earlier legal relations.

Further, the king caused the estates to be informed (in a second appendix) of fundamental points which to any impartial person (certainly!) cannot appear unsuitable to serve as the basis for negotiations about a good constitution.
zh: 在 11 月 13. 日的王家敕令中——这道敕令终于对等级议会迄今的书面攻讦之途径作出了裁决，虽然并不是对事情本身——人们着手处理了等级议会在法权上的主要主张，特别是关于归并的主张；并在一份专门的附件中揭示了这些主张的浅薄；其主要立场被重申：所关涉的是一部国家宪法，新旧两个领地应当借此结合为一个法权上的整体。
国王声明：既然德意志帝国的宪法已被扬弃，在法权不确定的情况下就连法官也不再存在，他不能仅仅停留在对旧有土地契约的一般性承认上，而不去逐项说明其内容。

首先必须对这份散见于许多文书之中、而且常常令人怀疑的内容作完整而清晰的阐述，好让那些符合宪法的规定不再是少数人的专有财产（那些旧日的委员会老爷们——甚至在这些人不全体、而主要只是他们那些法务顾问——的专有财产），而能够成为人民的共同财富。——在那种不幸的情形下：即关于一份共同宪法的协议未能达成，而等级议会仍旧拒绝就这样的宪法进行谈判，那么国王便决心：在他的本土领地中引入旧有的代表制；而在他的新领地中，则引入一部以真正的民族代表制为基础、同时顾及它们旧有法权关系的宪法。
此外，国王还让人把一些根本点告知等级议会（写在第二份附件中）；这些根本点对于任何一个不偏不倚的人（那当然！）来说，都不可能显得不适合作为就一部良好宪法进行谈判的基础。

en: The reason of the matter did after all prevail so far that the assembly resolved upon negotiations, though indeed only in something quite formal. - The Prince of Öttingen-Wallerstein proposed (XIII.
Abt., S. 138) that after a sufficient period the members should state their views on the royal rescript and that a committee should then examine them.

This proposal disturbed the usual course of handing over the report on a royal proposition at once to a committee, and probably to the ordinary members, and of seeing the unanimity of the assembly's resolution, on which such a committee had acquired a kind of monopoly, follow of itself.
Nevertheless it was decided to elect not a committee but four referents.

For some time past, moreover, it had already happened that even of a committee elected to report and to give an opinion, every single member brought his essay into the assembly and read it out; it seemed as if even a committee of a few could bring nothing else than a succession of monopolies, not a deliberation and a resolution within itself. - Now in the following sittings many essays were read out, several of which tended to the effect that even so one still could not enter into negotiations; for example that the matter concerned de iuribus singulorum, about which the majority of votes of the assembly could not decide, - a sacred principle of the former state law of the German empire, in which precisely the fundamental evil and the fundamental injustice consisted, that out of the rights of the state Iura singulorum had become.
zh: 事情本身的理性毕竟还是起了作用，等级会议决定进行谈判——尽管只是在某种纯粹形式的意义上。——厄廷根－瓦勒施泰因亲王殿下提出（《文件补编》 XIII.
，《文件补编》 S. 138）在一个足够宽限的期限之后，议员们应当陈述他们对王家敕令的看法，然后由一个委员会对这些看法加以审议。
这一提议打乱了惯常的做法：把关于一项王家提案的报告立即交给一个委员会——而且多半是交给那些普通成员——然后顺理成章地看到等级会议决议的一致通过，因为这样的委员会已经取得了某种垄断权。
但最后人们仍然决定：不选一个委员会，而是选出四名报告人。

此外，一段时间以来已经出现过这样的情况：就连被选出来作报告与提出意见的委员会，每个成员也都把自己的文章拿到等级会议上宣读；人们仿佛觉得，即便是一个由少数人组成的委员会，也带不来一场内部的商议与决议，所带来的只是一连串的垄断。——于是，在随后的几次会议中宣读了许多文章，其中好几篇的用意是：即便如此，人们仍然不能进入谈判；例如说，所涉的是 de iuribus singulorum（个人的权利），而等级会议的多数票对这类问题无法作出决定；——这是德意志帝国旧国家法中一条神圣的原则，而旧国家法的根本之害与根本之不义恰恰就在于此：从国家的权利中变成了个人的权利（Iura singulorum）。

en: Among other voices of the better sense, Mr von Varnbüler replied to Mr Lang (XV.

Abt., S. 59), who had admonished them to take conscience seriously and had called out with pathos: 'No negotiation', - that he (Mr v. V.) rather, with such a proposal, must consider conscience to be endangered, in that it might thereby come about all the more easily that they should receive no constitution at all.

'By that', he continues, 'that the old constitution legally persists, the people are not helped, and with learned treatises we cannot answer them, if it should one day call out to us: 'You have played an overweening game; you have set everything at naught; it was intended to give us:
zh: 在若干较为明智的发言中，冯·瓦恩布勒先生答复朗先生道（《文件补编》 XV.
，《文件补编》 S. 59）——这位先生曾告诫他们要认真对待良心，并且「以浮夸的声调呼喊」：「不许谈判」；——而他（瓦恩布勒先生）倒认为，在这样一项提议面前，必须认为良心受到了威胁，因为这样一来，最终反而更可能导致他们根本得不到任何宪法。
「靠这样——他继续说——让旧宪法在法权上继续存在，对人民是毫无帮助的；而如果我们有朝一日听到人民向我们呼喊：『你们玩了一场狂妄放肆的把戏；你们把一切都付之东流；人家本来是要给我们：」

en: participation in legislation, the right of granting taxes, the old church property, an account of the state expenditures, personal freedom, the responsibility of the state's servants, the right of emigration, the continued efficacy of the estates,
zh: 对立法的参与权、批准税赋的权利、旧有的教会财产、对国家支出的交代、人身自由、国家公务人员的责任、移居权、等级议会的持续效力、

en: but you have rejected everything!'
Who is to blame for the fact that we have lost everything?'
' - It is remarkable that several gentlemen of the nobility distinguished themselves here by more moderate and more impartial opinions before the other deputies. - Mr Bolley believed (XV.

Abt., S. 6), that he had to defend himself against the disapprobation which had not escaped him even during his address; he thought that the reproach of bitterness and mockery was not deserved, and that probably only his strong voice, with which he had delivered the address, had caused some offence.138) - It seems that the assembly had had enough of addresses in the old style and breadth, and a plain draft of an address by Mr Dr Weishaar, composed without bitterness, obstinacy and defamation of the king's intentions, was adopted by the assembly with 57 votes against 49 in the sitting of 23. November.

In it, with the expression of reassurance and gratitude, it is acknowledged that the obstacles to a union have been removed, and the appointment of the estates' plenipotentiaries for comparison negotiations is announced. - Mr Bolley sought, after this resolution had been taken, in the following sitting, while the voting slips for the election of the negotiating commissioners were still being handed in, to secure by the delivery of his scruples the insertion of some reservations into the address, because that excessively diplomatic refinement would prevent the estates from remaining true to their character so far; - in truth the plainness, openness and simplicity of the address contrasted sharply with the opposite character of the previous ones. - The assembly, however, remained with its resolution.
zh: ——但你们却把一切都抛弃了！」
是谁的过错，使我们失去了一切？」
「——值得注意的是，好几位贵族先生在这里以较为温和、也较为不带偏见的见解，胜过了其他议员。——博莱先生认为（《文件补编》 XV.

，《文件补编》 S. 6），他有必要为自己辩护——在他演说期间就已经显露出来的那些不满；他认为自己不应当受到「尖刻与嘲讽」的指责，而那大概只是因为他用以发表演说的洪亮的嗓音引起了一些反感。138)——等级会议似乎已经厌倦了旧式的、冗长的那些呈文；于是在 11 月 23. 日的会议上，一份由魏斯哈尔博士先生起草的、写得朴素的呈文草案——其中没有尖刻、没有强词夺理，也没有对国王意图的诋毁——以 57 票对 49 票获得通过。

其中在表达了安心与感谢之后承认：阻碍联合的障碍已被清除；同时也公布了等级议会全权代表的任命，以便进行协商性谈判。——在这项决议作出之后，博莱先生在随后一次会议上又费了一番心思：趁着选举谈判专员的选票还在递交的时候，他试图以陈述自己的顾虑为手段，促成在呈文中插入若干保留条款，因为那种过分的、外交式的精细将使等级议会不再忠于他们迄今的性格；——事实上，这份呈文的朴素、坦率与简单，同此前那些呈文截然相反的性格形成了鲜明的对照。——不过等级会议仍坚持它的决议。

en: In the instruction to the estates' commissioners it was to be entered as the purpose that a merely accessory recess should come about; this was rejected, but against it Mr Bolley still carried through the fine additional article (XVI.

Abt., S. 47), that the estates' commissioners should seize a suitable occasion to declare themselves definitively about the main purpose of the contract in the sense of the earlier representations; - in these, as mentioned above, a comparison was restricted to such a recess.
The negotiations, however, embraced the whole range of the constitutional subjects. - The commissioners on both sides held the first conference on 4 December 1815.
Later on (on 17 January 1816) an instructing committee of 12 members was set up alongside the estates' commissioners, and further on (on 29 February) one of 25 members.

The most distinguished part of the work of these members as well as of others whom it pleased, consisted in collecting materials on chapters of the old constitution according to an underlying plan, and then editing the individual subjects into an ordered connection of propositions, as to the content and wording of which the committee agreed, and with which the estates' commissioners entered into negotiations with the royal ones.

Since the estates had once displayed their disinclination or incapacity to comprehend anything general and to start from something of that kind, the fundamental articles accompanying the royal rescript of 13. November had also been entirely set aside and ignored by the assembly.

But now, since the compilation of the particular was taken as the starting point, the need arose of its own accord to lead these materials back to general propositions, for which the Prince of Öttingen-Wallerstein (XVII.
Abt., S. 58 and ibid. S. 145) made the motion.
This ascent to the general belongs to the formal side of the political education of a new assembly of the estates.
zh: 在给等级议会专员的训令中，本应写入这样一项宗旨：只须达成一份纯属附属性的决议；这一点被否决了；不过与此相对，博莱先生仍然促成了那一条精细的附加条款（《文件补编》 XVI.
，《文件补编》 S. 47），即：等级议会的专员应当抓住一个合适的机会，就契约的主要宗旨按照先前那些呈文的旨趣作出明确的表态；——而如上所述，在那些呈文中，一份协议被限制在这样一份决议的范围之内。
然而，谈判涵盖了整个宪法事项的范围。——双方的专员于 1815 年 12 月 4 日举行了第一次会议。
后来（1816 年 1 月 17 日）在等级议会一方另设了一个由 12 名成员组成的训导委员会，其后（2 月 29 日）又扩为 25 名成员。
这些成员——以及另一些自愿参与的人——工作中最体面的部分，是按照一个预设的计划收集关于旧宪法各章的材料，然后把各个事项编辑成一套有条理的命题；委员会就这些命题的内容与措辞达成一致，等级议会的专员便带着它们与国王方面的专员进行谈判。
既然等级议会已经显示过他们不愿或不能把握任何一般性的东西、不愿从这样的东西出发，那么随 11 月 13. 日王家敕令一同附来的那些根本条款，也就被等级会议完全搁置、无视了。
然而如今既然是以对个别事项的汇编为出发点，那么把这些材料归结为一般性命题的需要便自然地产生了；厄廷根－瓦勒施泰因亲王殿下为此提出（《文件补编》 XVII.
，《文件补编》 S. 58 与同处 S. 145）一项动议。
这种上升到一般层面的做法，属于一个新生的等级会议之政治教育的形式方面。

en: The fruits of this editing have appeared in print especially as a draft of the Württemberg constitution-contract to be renewed.

According to resolutions of the estates' instruction committee of 1816. - This work has a different appearance from a collection of diet recesses, ordinances of all sorts, etc., and also differs essentially from the old constitution in its content.
Such an ordered compilation of definite propositions makes the earlier fundamental laws into antiquities in fact.

The general clause appended to the draft, which had already lain at the heart of the assembly of the estates before, that all the land and house fundamental laws of the former duchy, in so far as they have not been altered by that draft, shall retain their continuously binding force, must always be conceded partly as something innocent for the appeasement of the formal conscience, partly is a constitution in general indeed something fixed, but not something simply at rest, but rather it is the sitting together of an assembly of the estates that is chiefly the continuous, quiet further formation of it. - This is the true general clause which world spirit hangs upon every existing constitution for itself. - The activity of an assembly of the estates, in so far as it has a material and content - otherwise it is no work at all -, or even the present handling of a constitutional draft, makes the formal principle of law, without any further content, which for months was the highest goal of this assembly, disappear of itself from men's heads.

A connected labour over a totality of constitution in definite propositions further makes it impossible in itself simply to hold on to positive determinations in the entanglement, dispersion and sheer multiplicity of those countless charters and rescripts cited above, and it leads one to use one's own understanding and reason, as in the so-called natural state law. - Effects which arise of themselves unconsciously in men's minds through the nature of the matter against their stiffest and most decidedly expressed notions, are always the most important result, for the sake of whose certainty clear-sighted ministries, as also the Württemberg one, looked beyond the preceding phenomena of passionate subjectivity, prejudices, distorted concepts, malice, etc.
zh: 这一编辑工作的成果尤其以付印的形式出现，那就是一份「待重新制定的符腾堡宪法契约」的草案。
根据等级议会训导委员会 1816 年的决议。——这项工作的样子与一批邦议会决议、各类敕令等等的汇编大不相同，就内容而言，它也与旧宪法有本质的差异。
这样一份有条有理的确定命题的汇编，事实上就把早先的基本法条变成了陈旧之物。

附在草案后面的总条款——它从前就已经为等级会议所深深关切：即旧公国的所有土地与家族基本法条，凡未被该草案更改者，皆继续保有其约束力——这一条总归必须一半作为某种无辜的东西、为了让形式上的良心得到安宁而让予，一半则是因为一部宪法总归是某种固定的东西，而不是某种单纯静止的东西；恰恰在于等级会议的集会，其工作正是对它不断而平静的继续塑造。——这就是世界精神为自己悬挂在任何既有宪法上的那条真正的总条款。——一个等级会议的活动，就它确实有材料与内容而言——否则它本来就谈不上什么工作——或者仅仅是眼下对一部宪法草案的加工，都会使那条没有更多内容的形式法权原则——它数月以来一直是这个会议的最高目标——自然而然地从人们的头脑中消失。

围绕一个宪法的整体、以确定的命题所作的有连续性的工作，还使得人们自身就不可能仅仅拘泥于上面所举的那无数文书与敕令的纠缠、零散以及数量之众多中的那些具体规定，并且它引导人们运用自己的知性与理性——如同在所谓的自然国家法中那样。——那些通过事情的本性而在人们头脑中不自觉地、针对他们最僵硬、最坚决地表达出来的那些看法而产生出来的效果，始终是最重要的成果；也正因为对这种成果的确定性，明察的各部——符腾堡的各部同样如此——才越过此前那些激情化的主观、偏见、乖谬的概念、憎恨等现象而另作别观。

en: As for the business of the assembly of the estates itself from December 1815 up to the same month of 1816, it referred partly to subjects other than constitutional ones and partly to these.

Among those were, among other things, in part particular further developments with regard to the standesherren; it has already been touched upon above that one cannot well see how a German assembly of the estates is still to enter into activity at all if these relations are not first determined.

If such an assembly itself is to be used, as it appeared here at the beginning, as a means of first asserting the claims of this estate, then the estates thereby show themselves as not yet organised. - Among the other matters which here too may be passed over because of their slight interest - the institution of the scribal absurdity has been considered above - the royal assessment and collection of the annual taxes in particular caused a great stir.

Also on 20 October 1815 the king had begun to have conveyed to the estates a number of explanations and corrections, contained in the reports of the ministries, regarding what they had set forth in their essay of grievances, and also some altering determinations occasioned thereby.
In the explanations the shallowness of some of the views set forth in the said essay was shown up.
The assembly afterwards appointed a committee on these subjects, but later dissolved it like most of its committees, without the matters being dealt with any further.

All the members not included in the negotiating committee were combined on 29 February into a large committee of several sections, which were to distribute among themselves the grievances and general matters and to work on them in particular. - But nothing at all has come to light from the work of these sections.
If their work had led to an effective negotiation with the ministry, then what had already been rejected earlier would have happened, namely an entering into the grievances.
zh: 至于等级会议自身从 1815 年 12 月到 1816 年同一个月的各项事务，它们一部分涉及宪法事项以外的题目，一部分则涉及这些题目。
其中属于这一类的，还有就等级领主而言的某些具体进展；上面已经提到：倘若这些关系事先没有确定下来，那么一个德国的等级会议眼下究竟如何能够开始发挥作用，实在无从看出。
如果这样一个会议本身——正如开头所显现的那样——将被用作首先主张这一阶层之要求的手段，那么等级议会恰恰由此显示出自己还没有组织起来。——在其余那些同样因为微不足道而在此可以略过的事务中（文书吏之弊这一机构上面已经考察过），尤其是王家的年度税赋开征与征收，引起了大骚动。
此外，国王早在 1815 年 10 月 20 日就开始让人把各部报告中所含的、关于他们在陈情文章中所提出之事的说明与更正，以及由此引起的一些更改条款，转交给等级议会。
在这些说明中，上面那篇文章所提出的某些见解的浅薄被揭示了出来。
等级会议随后就这些事项任命了一个委员会，但后来像他们的大多数委员会那样又把它解散了，而这些事情却没有得到进一步的处理。
所有未被纳入谈判委员会的成员，在 2 月 29 日被合并进一个由若干分科组成的大委员会；这些分科应当把陈情与一般性事务在彼此之间分配开来并加以专门处理。——可是，这些分科的工作却根本没有产生出任何东西。
倘若它们的工作曾促成与各部的有效谈判，那么就会发生此前早已被否决的那件事：对陈情的让步。

en: With such current subjects as the assessment and collection of the annual taxes and others, the attempt which the assembly felt itself driven to make from time to time came into a dilemma about its position.

It could exercise neither the rights of participation as an old Württemberg assembly of the estates - for it was not such - nor the rights which would have been granted to it by the royal charter - for it did not want those -, nor yet according to the new comparison, for that had not come about.
Hence there came later on, in June 1816, discussions about this dilemma, as to whether the assembly were competent for this, constituted or not constituted (XXV.
Abt.) took place.
The royal ministry rejected the attempts of the estates to pass for constituted by the nature of their relation at the time.
zh: 在年度税赋的开征与征收等等这些日常事务上，等级会议不时感到自己不得不作出的那番尝试，反而使它在自己的处境上陷入了两难。
它既不能作为老符腾堡的等级会议来行使参与的权利——因为它并不是这样的会议；也不能行使王家宪章本该赋予它的那些权利——因为它并不想要这些权利；按照新的协议，它同样无从行使——因为那份协议尚未达成。
因此到了后来，1816 年 6 月又出现了关于这一两难的讨论：这个会议在此事上是否有资格、是否已经「组建成立」（《文件补编》 XXV.
《文件补编》）。
王家各部以他们当时关系之性质为由，驳回了等级议会自称已经「组建成立」的各种努力。

en: The business concerning the constitutional comparison, however, the assembly had transferred to its commissioners and committees.
At first (from 1. December 1815) it kept secret the sittings in which it was reported to it on such subjects, and kept separate protocols of them.
But after the detail of the negotiations had been transferred to the committee, it (on 25 January 1816) again lifted this secrecy. - Earlier already, on the 15th of the same month (XVII.

Abt., S. 144), the commissioners made the motion that the individual sections of the constitutional work should not be brought before the assembly, but that the whole should first be worked out completely.
Mr Knapp stated in the committee (13. February 1816, XIX.

Abt., S. 75) among other things that in the manner of the negotiations as arranged, furthermore that it does not befit a diplomatic body in the relation between the king and [den] the estates, only five members [regularly] and seven (the committee then consisted of twelve) were at times active and effective, all the others however were occupied almost only with insignificant matters.
On the question of how during the negotiations the assembly was to exercise its function at all and in relation to the constitution, a resolution was now taken (on 29 February 1816, XX.

Abt., S. 28): that not one chapter after another, but one day the whole constitutional draft should be brought to the deliberation of the estates, and that in the meantime the committee should report to them from time to time on the course of the negotiations in general.
Afterwards the previously mentioned union of the rest of the assembly into a committee of several sections also took place.
zh: 不过，关于宪法协议的事务，等级会议已经交给了自己的专员与委员会。
起初（自 1815 年 12 月 1. 日起），凡是有就这类事项向它作汇报的会议，它都保密举行，并且另设专门的会议记录。
但在谈判的细节事项交给委员会之后，它便于（1816 年 1 月 25 日）取消了这种保密。——其实更早，在同一个月的 15 日（《文件补编》 XVII.
，《文件补编》 S. 144），专员们就提出动议：宪法工作的各个部分不应当提交等级会议，而是应当先把整体完整地做出来。
克纳普先生在委员会上提出（1816 年 2 月 13. 日，《文件补编》 XIX.
，《文件补编》 S. 75），除别的以外：在所规定的谈判方式之下，此外，作为这样一种外交机构，它同国王与[den]等级议会之间的关系并不相称，因而只有五名成员[经常地]、另有七名（那时委员会由十二人组成）只是偶尔起作用、起作用，其余的人则几乎只是忙于一些无关紧要的题目。
关于等级会议在谈判期间究竟应当如何、并且就宪法而言如何履行自己的职责这个问题，如今作出了如下决议（1816 年 2 月 29 日，《文件补编》 XX.
，《文件补编》 S. 28）：不是一章接一章地，而是日后把整部宪法草案提交等级议会审议；与此同时，委员会应当不时向等级会议汇报谈判的总进程。
此后，前面提到过的、将其余议员并入一个由若干分科组成的大委员会之事，也同样发生了。

en: Thus the assembly found itself of its own accord in the situation which the king had wanted to bring about by its adjournment at the end of July 1815, which had so highly excited their passion and in which they believed they had no longer much to lose in the matter.

The superfluity of their sitting together during a whole year without real efficacy, neither for the constitution nor for other subjects, seems not to have been removed by the consideration of the increase in costs.
Mr Knapp said in an address of 9 February 1816 (XIX.

Abt., S. 23), that one now hears already, and not without justification, the question: 'What is the use of an assembly of more than a hundred men, what the use of a daily expenditure of more than a hundred ducats, if only a few have to manage the business, or [the rest] occupy themselves only with lesser matters, which could also have been managed by a few?' - The assembly remained indebted for an answer.
zh: 于是，等级会议便自行处在国王借 1815 年 7 月底休会而想要造成的那种处境之中：这处境极大地激起了他们的激情，而他们自以为在这件事上已经没有什么可损失的了。
整整一年毫无实际效力——既不为宪法，也不为其他任何题目——的集会之多余，看来并没有因为考虑到费用增加而被消除。
克纳普先生在 1816 年 2 月 9 日的一篇演说中（《文件补编》 XIX.
，《文件补编》 S. 23），人们现在就已经听到、而且并非没有道理地听到这样一问：「一个一百多人的会议有何用处？每天一百多杜卡特的花费又有何用处？既然只有少数人须要处理事务，或者[其余的人]只忙于一些次要题目——而这些同样可以由少数人处理——」——等级会议一直欠着这个问题的答案。

en: From the constitutional draft, throughout the year, there were now read out to the assembly from time to time, partly on the commission of the committees, individual chapters, partly also other essays and so-called materials for such a draft.
Then the Allgemeine Zeitung and other 'unknown' writers could also be counted among those taking part in the business and the entertainment of the assembly.

The right of frank judgement and voices other than the former praises of the newspapers and journals seemed to it something so alien that against newspaper articles and pamphlets just as against royal rescripts, deliberations were held, committees appointed, and lengthy essays - essays which became books - read out before the assembly, which justified themselves by it and which, as was said, 'the slanders and calumnies hatched against them' were sometimes refuted in a piquant manner, as was likewise said.
zh: 整整一年里，人们不时向等级会议宣读与宪法草案有关的东西：有时是奉委员会之命宣读其中某一章，有时则是其他文章以及所谓供此类草案使用的材料。
于是，《法兰克福总汇报报》以及其他「不知名的」写作者，也可以算是参与了等级会议的事务与消遣。
公开而直率的评论的权利，以及与报纸和期刊迄今那些赞美之词不同的声音，在它看来显得如此陌生，以至于：针对报纸文章与小册子，正如针对王家敕令一样，人们进行商议、任命委员会，并在等级会议面前宣读冗长的文章——那些成为书籍的文章；这些文章以此为自己辩护，而对于人们所谓的「针对它们炮制的嘲讽与诽谤」，有时也以人们同样所谓的一种俏皮方式加以驳斥。

en: In the sitting of 17 September 1816 (XXX.
Abt., 1.
St., S. 32) it was announced that the instruction committee had finished its works relating to the constitution, which were now to be presented to the assembly one after another.
Some of them were still read out.

But even in this last quarter of the year the assembly did not come to a deliberation on them, much less to resolutions. - Shortly before the death of King Friedrich II, which took place in the night from 29 to 30 October 1816, on 24 October in the assembly (XXXII.
Abt., S. 48) the discontent with the scribal absurdity once more became audible.
The announcement of a shocking case seemed to tear them out of their lethargy in this respect.

The committee appointed for this was reinforced, and since Mr Knapp, 'because of the constitutional business accumulated since eight months', had not been able to finish the report entrusted to him, and the assembly had come to no deliberation, on 21. November an address (XXXIII.

Abt., S. 99 f.) was now presented to the new regent, and he was asked to appoint a joint royal and lands commission to which the work should now be entrusted which had so far been expected from the estates.

For the joint work with royal deputies it is stated: because these bring with them great experience, which only the highest authorities can have, - an admission which might also well have been present at the drafting of an essay of grievances, the organisation of estates and in other cases. - But since 'every month of delay damages the land sensibly' (why had the assembly hesitated so many months over a work on their side? it had appointed its first committee on 13. May 1815, that is, eighteen months before), so it only laid before the regent a committee report on provisional means, which it did not indeed make its own, and on this point too it had produced no proposals for a remedy from its side.
Now, after the king on 6 December (XXXIII.

Abt., S. 150) had given the estates to understand that he had entrusted the Privy Council with the examination of the draft of a charter of the constitution and of the counter-draft that had emerged from it, and had adjourned them until 15 January 1817, the assembly dispersed.
zh: 在 1816 年 9 月 17 日的会议上（《文件补编》 XXX.
《文件补编》1. 册，
，S. 32）会上宣布：训导委员会已经完成了它与宪法有关的工作，这些工作此后将陆续提交等级议会。
其中若干篇还当场宣读了。
但即便在这最后一个季度里，等级会议也没有就这些文件进行任何商议，更不用说作出决议了。——就在腓特烈二世国王于 1816 年 10 月 29 日至 30. 日夜间去世前不久，在 10 月 24 日的等级会议上（《文件补编》 XXXII.
《文件补编》 S. 48），针对文书吏之弊的不满又一次公开表露了出来。
对一个骇人案件的揭发，似乎把他们从这方面一直以来的昏睡中震醒了过来。
为此任命的委员会得到了加强；由于克纳普先生「因为这八个月来堆积如山的宪法事务」而未能完成交付给他的报告，而等级会议也未曾进行任何商议，于是 11 月 21. 日向新任统治者递交了一份呈文（《文件补编》 XXXIII.
，《文件补编》 S. 99 f.），请求他设立一个王家与等级双方共同组成的委员会；此前一直期待由等级议会承担的那份工作，现在应当委托给它。

至于与王家代表共同工作这一点，其理由被列为：因为他们带来只有最高机关才可能具有的丰富经验；——这一坦白，在起草陈情文章、组织等级议会以及其他场合中，大概也本可以出现。——但由于「每一个月的耽搁都会使土地受到明显的损害」（等级议会方面究竟为什么为了一件工作耽搁了这么多个月？它早在 1815 年 5 月 13. 日就设立了第一个委员会——那是十八个月以前），所以它只递交了一份关于临时性办法的委员会意见书；而这份意见书它本来就没有当作自己的东西，至于在这方面它也至今没有从自己这边拿出任何补救的提案。
如今，在国王于 12 月 6 日（《文件补编》 XXXIII.
，《文件补编》 S. 150）让等级议会明白：他已把一份宪法文书草案以及由此产生的反草案的审查委托给枢密院，并把会议休会至 1817 年 1 月 15 日——于是等级会议散会了。

en: After this so extensive exposition - whose subject one would misapprehend if one were to suppose in it the purpose of a defence of something other than of the concept of the estates bound up with the highest interest, against the reality so unfitting to it and yet so presumptuous, which has been depicted to the public through the printing of their deliberations and put forward for judgement - there is only still to be mentioned the remarkable final result, namely the fate of this assembly, that throughout the whole course of its long and costly sitting together it brought about neither an agreement with the king nor, within itself, any resolution on the content of any constitutional subject.
zh: 在这番如此铺陈的叙述之后——如果人们把它读作是在为别的什么作辩护，而不是在替那个同最高利益相联结的「等级议会」概念辩护、去对抗那对它如此不相称却又如此僭妄的现实（这现实已通过他们审议的印本向公众加以描述，并被摆出来供人评判），那么人们就会误解它的对象——就只需再指出那个奇特的结果：等级会议的命运——在整个漫长而昂贵的集会过程中，它既没有与国王达成任何协议，也没有在自身内部就任何一个宪法事项的内容作出任何决议。
